clue.text: Entertain model after do

indicators.note: the model follows the do, so its letters come second

parts.note: to do someone is to swindle or con them
a template is a pattern or model to copy

explanation.surface: Someone at a party is entertained by a model after a social do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' looks like a party but is the verb 'swindle', giving CON.
explanation.definitionFit: To entertain an idea is to consider or ponder it, a synonym.

clue.text: Oceanic residents cruising around sea initially

definitions.text: Oceanic residents cruising around sea initially

indicators.note: initially tells us to take the opening letter of each of the five preceding words

explanation.surface: Sea creatures patrolling the waters, a picture of killer whales on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: the first letters of the five words spell the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Killer whales live in the ocean and cruise around it, so they are oceanic residents.

clue.text: Place for supporters to see Queen in spot

indicators.note: in tells us the Queen sits inside the word for spot

parts.note: a spot or trace is a tiny amount
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: Football fans hoping to catch sight of the monarch somewhere in the stands.
explanation.walkthrough: A terrace is the standing area of a British football ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Football fans traditionally stood on terraces, the stepped standing areas of a stadium.

clue.text: Chap put on island about turned loony

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting the chap on the island places his letters above it

parts.note: a chap is a man

indicators.note: turned tells us the letters for about are read backwards

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A man marooned on an island goes mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A loony is a madman, a synonym for a crazed person.

clue.text: Woody is on glue, smashed

indicators.note: smashed means broken to pieces, so the letters of the phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone called Woody is high on glue and wrecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smashed' looks like slang for intoxicated but signals the anagram; Woody looks like a name.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes something made of or resembling wood, so it means woody.

clue.text: Measure cost supporting bird

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath, so the cost comes below the bird

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a rate is a charge or cost

explanation.surface: Working out what it costs to keep a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, titration measures the concentration of a solution, so to titrate is to measure.

clue.text: A French mature brie finally deemed authentic

parts.note: un is the French for a
an adult is grown up or mature

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word brie

parts.note: to be rated is to be judged or deemed

explanation.surface: A ripe French cheese judged to be the genuine article.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pure and unmixed is genuine, so it is authentic.

clue.text: Propose, as into name changes

indicators.note: changes says the letters of the two words take a new order

explanation.surface: Suggesting someone, as a name changes hands.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone forward as a candidate is to propose them.

clue.text: Meatier tinned liquid could be uncertain

indicators.note: liquid means fluid and unfixed, so the letters flow into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Tinned meat in a watery sauce could be of dubious nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not fixed or settled is vague, a synonym for uncertain.

clue.text: More attractive Mediterranean resort by river's mouth

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

indicators.note: a river's mouth is where it begins at the sea, here its first letter

explanation.surface: A seaside town by an estuary sounds an attractive place.
explanation.definitionFit: The comparative of a word meaning pleasant or pleasing, so more attractive.

clue.text: After bedtime, it's what one's got up in?

definitions.text: After bedtime, it's what one's got up in?

parts.words: After bedtime, it's what one's got up in?
parts.note: got up in suggests waking and rising, but here it means dressed in: the garment worn at night

explanation.walkthrough: 'got up in' reads as rising from bed, but 'got up' also means dressed, as in a costume.
explanation.definitionFit: A long garment worn in bed is what one is dressed in at night.

clue.text: Detective's anger about old man getting run down

indicators.note: the detective's anger goes about, around, the old man

parts.note: DI, Detective Inspector, plus the S of the possessive
rage is fierce anger
pa, father, is one's old man

explanation.surface: An inspector furious about his father being knocked down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run down' looks like a road accident, but it means belittle; 'about' wraps the detective's anger around the old man.
explanation.definitionFit: To run someone down is to belittle or criticise them, a synonym.

clue.text: Girl caught inside a tale?

indicators.note: inside places the caught letter within the word for tale

parts.note: a tale can be a lie, a made-up story
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A girl trapped in a story, perhaps in Wonderland.
explanation.definitionFit: A common girl's name, famous from Lewis Carroll's stories.

clue.text: Flexible member joining ends of extensor

parts.note: a limb is a member of the body

indicators.note: ends of picks the first and last letters of extensor

explanation.surface: Anatomy: a supple limb with an extensor muscle attached at its ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Supple and loose-jointed, as an athlete warming up, so flexible.

clue.text: Calm partner eating Italian icing vacantly

indicators.note: the partner eats the other pieces, so they go inside

parts.note: a mate is a partner

indicators.note: vacantly means emptied of its inside, leaving the first and last letters of icing

explanation.surface: Someone soothing a partner who is absently nibbling Italian icing.
explanation.definitionFit: To lessen the severity of something is to soothe or calm it.

clue.text: Express disapproval with delay in double English teaching

parts.note: tut is the sound expressing disapproval

indicators.note: in puts the delay between the two English letters
double says the letter for English appears twice

parts.note: a lag is a delay

explanation.surface: A teacher tutting at a pupil's slowness in a double English lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutelage is instruction or guardianship, so teaching.

clue.text: Part of reggae's the technique used by aficionado

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a stretch of letters running across these words

explanation.surface: A reggae connoisseur using a particular musical technique.
explanation.definitionFit: A person devoted to art and beauty is a connoisseur, close to an aficionado.

clue.text: Food and board surrounded by endless comfort

indicators.note: the board sits inside the shortened comfort word
endless removes the final letter from the comfort word

parts.note: ease is comfort
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: Bed and board offered in unlimited comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims EASE to EAS. 'board' looks like meals, but it is a table.
explanation.definitionFit: Eatables are things fit to eat, so food in general.

clue.text: Instrument playing encapsulating old instrument

parts.note: a bass is a low-pitched instrument such as the double bass

indicators.note: encapsulating says the playing word holds the old letter

parts.note: something playing is on, as a show is on

explanation.surface: One instrument being played with an antique one tucked inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind with a double reed playing in the low register is an orchestral instrument.

clue.text: Leader of socialists, finest joker?

indicators.note: Leader of picks the first letter of socialists

parts.note: the cream is the finest, the best of a group

explanation.surface: A party leader, the best of the bunch, is something of a comedian.
explanation.walkthrough: A scream is a very funny person; the question mark flags the loose definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A hilarious person is called a scream, so a joker, informally.

clue.text: Cold type of ice cream in hamper

parts.note: raspberry ripple is vanilla ice cream streaked with raspberry sauce

explanation.surface: A picnic hamper packed with a chilled ripple ice cream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hamper' looks like a basket but is the verb. Raspberry ripple is a classic British ice cream.
explanation.definitionFit: To hinder or disable something badly is to hamper it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Single's following previous aniseed drink

indicators.note: the single's letters follow the word for previous

parts.note: past means previous, former
single gives I, the Roman one, and the 's stands for is: I plus S

explanation.surface: A lone drinker sipping an aniseed spirit after an earlier one.
explanation.definitionFit: A French aperitif flavoured with aniseed, usually drunk diluted with water.

clue.text: US soldier in ocean capsized, getting protection

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the reversed ocean word
capsized means turned over, so the ocean word is reversed

parts.note: the sea is the ocean
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: An American soldier in a capsized vessel is rescued.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsized' gives AES, the ocean read backwards, before the soldier goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Under someone's aegis means under their protection or sponsorship.

clue.text: Skill overturning idiot's stupid new belief

indicators.note: overturning means the skill word is reversed

parts.note: art is skill

indicators.note: stupid means daft, so the letters of idiot are muddled

parts.note: the word idiot, with 's as is linking it to its signal

explanation.surface: Skill overturns a fool's daft belief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturning' turns ART to TRA; 'stupid' turns IDIOT to DITIO.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradition is a long-held custom or belief passed down.

clue.text: One struggles to find climbing plants

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
vies means competes, struggles

explanation.surface: Someone battles to locate creepers.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy is a climbing evergreen, so its plural names several climbing plants.

clue.text: Former vagrant tucking into sober mixer

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: the vagrant tucks into the sober letters

parts.note: TT, teetotal, means sober
a rover wanders, a vagrant

explanation.surface: An ex-tramp turns up at a party for teetotallers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixer' looks like a drink but is a sociable person.
explanation.definitionFit: An outgoing, sociable person mixes readily, so is a good mixer.

clue.text: Top of beer containing oxygen

indicators.note: the beer contains the oxygen letter

parts.note: a pint is a glass of beer
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: The frothy head on a beer is full of air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top of beer' suggests the froth, but 'Top' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The point of something is its tip, its top end.

clue.text: Enterprise warping, catching last of Klingons to scatter

indicators.note: the rearranged letters catch the final letter inside them
warping means bending out of shape, so the letters of the starship's name are rearranged
last of picks the final letter of Klingons

explanation.surface: The starship Enterprise at warp speed, catching Klingons and scattering them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'warping' is the anagram signal, borrowed from Star Trek's warp drive.
explanation.definitionFit: To intersperse is to scatter things among others, a synonym.
